name: Dal with Tempering (Tadka Dal)
description: Dal with tempering, also called tadka dal, is a very common Indian dish made with lentils. The dal is first cooked until soft, and then hot oil with spices is added on top. This tempering gives strong aroma, flavor, and makes the dal taste rich and delicious. It is usually eaten with rice or roti and is perfect for students because it is healthy, cheap, and easy to prepare.
ingredients: 1 cup dal (toor dal or moong dal)
steps: Wash the dal well with water.
Add dal, water, and turmeric to a pot or cooker.
Cook until the dal becomes soft and mushy.
Heat oil or ghee in a small pan for tempering.
Add mustard seeds and let them crackle.
Add cumin seeds, dry red chilies, garlic, onion, and curry leaves.
Add asafoetida and cook until golden and aromatic.
Pour this hot tempering over the cooked dal.
Mix well and serve hot with rice.

name: Jeera Rice
description: Jeera rice is a simple rice dish flavored with cumin seeds. It smells good, tastes light, and goes well with dal or curry. It is a nice choice when students want something quick but tasty.
steps: Wash the rice and keep it ready.
Add jeera and cook for a few seconds.
Cook until the rice becomes soft and fluffy.

name: Tamarind Rice
description: Tamarind rice is a popular South Indian dish with a tangy and slightly spicy taste. It is made by mixing cooked rice with tamarind pulp and a seasoned spice mixture. It keeps well, so it is useful for lunch boxes and travel meals.
steps: Soak tamarind in warm water and take out the pulp.
Add mustard seeds, chana dal, urad dal, chilies, and peanuts.
Add tamarind pulp, salt, and turmeric and cook until thick.
Mix this tamarind mixture into the cooked rice.

name: Chicken Curry
description: Chicken curry is a rich and flavorful dish made with chicken, onions, tomatoes, and spices. It tastes good with rice or chapati and is a popular meal in many Indian homes.
steps: Cook until the chicken becomes tender.

name: Egg Curry
description: Egg curry is a simple dish made with boiled eggs in a spicy onion and tomato gravy. It is easier than chicken curry and is good for students who want a filling meal with basic ingredients.
steps: Boil the eggs and remove the shells.
Cook onion and tomato with spices.
Add a little water to make gravy.
Put the eggs into the curry.
Cook for a few minutes and serve.

name: Laddu
description: Laddu is a round Indian sweet often made during festivals and celebrations. It is sweet, soft, and rich. Many families prepare different types of laddu at home.

name: Gulab Jamun
description: Gulab jamun is a famous Indian sweet made from soft dough balls that are fried and soaked in sugar syrup. It is very sweet and is often served at parties and special occasions.
steps: Make soft dough with milk powder and flour.
Prepare sugar syrup in another pan.
Put fried balls into the syrup.

name: Semiya
description: Semiya is a sweet dish made with vermicelli, milk, and sugar. It is soft and comforting and is often prepared quickly for guests or family dessert.
steps: Add milk and cook until soft.

name: Halwa
description: Halwa is a soft and warm Indian sweet. It is easy to make and has a rich taste because of ghee and sugar.

name: Jeera Water
description: Jeera water is a light and simple drink made with cumin seeds and water. It is often taken as a refreshing and soothing drink.

name: Buttermilk
description: Buttermilk is a cool and simple drink that is perfect for hot weather. It is light, refreshing, and easy to make with curd and water.
steps: Put curd and water in a bowl.

name: Lemon Soda
description: Lemon soda is a refreshing drink made with lemon, soda, salt, and sugar. It is quick to prepare and is very popular in warm weather.
steps: Squeeze lemon juice into a glass.
Add a little salt and sugar.

name: Lassi
description: Lassi is a cool and refreshing yogurt drink. It is smooth, simple, and perfect for hot days.
steps: Put yogurt, water, and sugar in a mixer.

name: Sharbath
description: Sharbath is a sweet and colorful drink for warm days. It is simple to make and is liked by many people.
